description: This file defines a set of React components for a customizable UI menubar, utilizing Radix UI primitives and lucide icons. It exports components like Menubar, MenubarItem, MenubarTrigger, and others, with styling and behavior tailored for a consistent menubar interface.

methods.name: Menubar
methods.description: Main component rendering the root of the menubar, styled with background, flex layout, and shadow.

methods.name: MenubarMenu
methods.description: Component representing a menu within the menubar.

methods.name: MenubarPortal
methods.description: Portal component for rendering menu content outside the DOM hierarchy.

methods.name: MenubarTrigger
methods.description: Component for triggering menu open/close, styled with focus and state styles.

methods.name: MenubarContent
methods.description: Component for the menu content panel with animation and positioning.

methods.name: MenubarItem
methods.description: Individual menu item with styling for variants and disabled state.

methods.name: MenubarCheckboxItem
methods.description: Checkbox menu item with indicator icon.

methods.name: MenubarRadioItem
methods.description: Radio button menu item with indicator icon.

methods.name: MenubarLabel
methods.description: Label within the menu, optionally inset.

methods.name: MenubarSubTrigger
methods.description: Trigger for opening a submenu, with icon indicator.

methods.name: MenubarSubContent
methods.description: Content panel for submenus with animation.
